#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# freeze.sh - Marks the migration as write-frozen.
#
# Creates a frozen.flag file to signal that writes are frozen, and
# prints a confirmation message.

set -euo pipefail

# Resolve the directory this script lives in so the flag is always
# created alongside the script, regardless of the caller's cwd.
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
FLAG_FILE="${SCRIPT_DIR}/frozen.flag"

touch "${FLAG_FILE}"

echo "Writes frozen"
